note: Rules tracked by core.paper_runner. start = first decision of the forward record. allocation_pct is the share of account equity this rule's own sleeve may hold when orders are placed; 0 means shadow only. Every rule here has a sleeve (see core/sleeves.py): orders are tagged with the rule id, and the shadow record stays the official scoreboard. Month-end stock rules and signal rules place orders when `python -m core.paper_runner run --execute` runs after the close (DAY market orders, filled at the next open); snapshot rules place market-on-close orders from `python -m core.snapshot_orders --execute` at 15:45. Entries with kind "signal" are single-symbol rules run by core.signal_tracker; kind "snapshot" are 15:45-signal stock rules run by core.snapshot_tracker. Sleeve sizes (2026-10-15): the decile rule stays at 50 as decided on 2026-10-14; the others are sized so the total (135) stays under max_gross_exposure_pct; the XLK sleeve is 5 because max_position_pct is 5.
